name: Adaptive Sampling Step with Early Ray Termination
aliases: Pas d'échantillonnage volumique et arrêt précoce
definition: Optimization technique for rendering distant data by decreasing sampling frequency based on distance to the viewpoint, combined with early ray termination.
summary: Adaptive Sampling Step with Early Ray Termination optimizes distant volumetric rendering by dynamically adjusting step sizes based on distance and skipping opaque regions, distinguished by its use of a pre-integrated transfer function to maintain brightness consistency.
